description: Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. Coverage: Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Share of fixed broadband subscriptions >= 100 Mbps - Advertised downlo; Share of fixed broadband subscriptions >= 10 Mbps - Advertised downloa; DSL subscriptions share in fixed broadband; Share of fixed broadband subscriptions >= 30 Mbps - Advertised downloa. Formats seen: CSV, RDF_XML, RDF_N_TRIPLES, ZIP, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-cnect.
